- `centromeres_hg38.tsv`: hg38 centromere coordinates (columns chr, start, cen.left.base, cen.right.base, end;
  1-based; chrX as `chr23`), the `chromosome_coordinates_hg38_chr.txt` table of Battenberg
  (https://github.com/Wedge-lab/battenberg). Default `centromeres` of the caller (`hg38_centromeres()`).
- `sample_template.yaml`: the sample yaml read by `splongcn --config` and `call_scn.R --config`.
